entities.summary: Treaty of Nasuh Pasha was a treaty between the Ottoman Empire and Safavid Iran signed on 20 November 1612. It was made after a decisive Safavid victory in the war of 1603–1612. The main terms in the treaty included granting back Safavid suzerainty over all of the Caucasus.
